text: APPROVE. I traced the extracted stages (unfinished checks, pin, suite, engine gates, bench) against the original and found the same check order, verdict arguments and early-return conditions; the pass-reason string and `Passed` verdict are built identically. JudgeAsync is now a flat sequence of about a dozen branches, well under 15. I found nothing that should break a warnings-as-errors build, though I could not compile it here and could not rule out an analyzer warning such as CA1822 on the new instance helpers.
